# U38: A leader reads the quarters, inspects a week, asks for an update and takes it back; an owner’s double press posts once

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `QUARTER-RESULTS`, `WEEK-INSPECTOR`, `NO-DOUBLE-POST`, `ASK-UNDO`, `STICKY-HEAD`, `ONE-ASK`
- **Budget:** at most 24 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `entry`, `one-action` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/goals?scope=all&view=history` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U38

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- _Note:_ History opens on each quarter's actual against plan, not the owners' weekly calls.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=history` in the demo.
- **Check:** The qtable (`.qtable`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `met > 0 && missed > 0 && (await p.locator('.qcell').filter({ hasText: 'In progress' }).count()) > 0`, where `const met = await p.locator('.qcell.q-met').count()`; `const missed = await p.locator('.qcell.q-missed').count()`. Else it says: quarter results should show met, missed and in progress; saw {met} met, {missed} missed.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “quarter results”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Weekly status, one quarter at a time or the whole year, with the selected week in words.
- **Step.** Press the “Weekly status” button in the “Show” group.
- **Check:** The History grid shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Q3” button in the “Weeks shown” group.
- **Step.** Press the “Whole year” button in the “Weeks shown” group.
- **Check:** “Week 45” is shown in the week inspector (`.week-inspector`) (else: the inspector does not start on this week).
- _Note:_ By keyboard: one tab stop, then the arrow keys.
- Move the focus to the td (`td[tabindex="0"]`) in the History grid.
- Press the ArrowLeft key.
- Press the ArrowLeft key.
- **Check:** “Week {NOW - 2}” is shown in the week inspector (`.week-inspector`) (else: the arrow keys do not move the selected week).
- _Note:_ By touch or mouse: a square.
- **Step.** Press the hcell (`td.hcell`) in the table row in the tbody (`tbody tr`) in the History grid (number 2) (number 10).
- **Check:** “Week 10” is shown in the week inspector (`.week-inspector`) (else: tapping a square does not select it).
- **Check:** (`progress`) met when `/27/.test(q3) && /(On track|At risk|Off track|Done|No check-in)/.test(said)`, where `const q3 = await p.locator('.hgrid').first().locator('thead th:nth-child(2)').innerText().catch(() => '')`; `const inspector = p.locator('.week-inspector')`; `const said = await inspector.innerText()`. Else it says: Q3 starts “{q3}”; the inspector said “{said.replace(/\n/g, ' ')}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “week inspector”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The Table's header stays in view while the goals scroll under it.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&view=table` in the demo.
- **Check:** The column heading in the thead (`thead th`) in the gtable (`.gtable`) (number 2) shows.
- **Check:** (`parity`) met when `stuck.table < 0 && stuck.top >= 0 && stuck.top <= 90 && stuck.bottom > stuck.top + 40`, where `const stuck = await p.evaluate(() => { const t = document.querySelector('.gtable'); const th = t.querySelector('thead th'); const r = th.getBoundingClientRect(); return { top: Math.round(r.top), table: Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().top), bottom: Math.round(t.getBoundingClientRect().bottom) }; })`. Else it says: the table header scrolled away: {JSON.stringify(stuck)}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “sticky header”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Asking Kojo for an update shows as asked, with an Undo; undone (withdrawn), it leaves his Home too.
- Go to `/goals/env-search` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Ask Kojo for an update” button.
- **Check:** “Asked Kojo for an update” is shown (else: asking does not show as asked).
- Look as Kojo (`kojo`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `kojo`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Updates asked for” is shown (else: the ask is not on Kojo’s Home, under its kind).
- **Check:** “Amara asked” is shown (else: Kojo’s Home does not say who asked).
- Look as Amara (`amara`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `amara`).
- Go to `/goals/env-search` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Undo” button.
- **Check:** The “Ask Kojo for an update” button shows.
- Look as Kojo (`kojo`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `kojo`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Check:** The page shows.
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `left === 0 && ask?.status === 'withdrawn' && asks.some((c) => c.action === 'asked') && asks.some((c) => c.action === 'withdrawn')`, where `const left = await p.getByText('Updates asked for').count()`; `const s1 = await h.snapshot()`; `const ask = (s1.requests || []).filter((r) => r.kind === 'update' && r.goalIds[0] === 'env-search' && r.askedBy === 'amara').pop()`; `const asks = s1.changes.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'env-search' && c.entity === 'request' && c.entityId === (ask && ask.id))`. Else it says: undoing left {left} asks on Home; the ask is {ask?.status}; logged {asks.map((c) => c.action).join(', ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “ask undone”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Tariq presses Post twice before the screen can react: one check-in, not two.
- Look as Tariq (`tariq`) in the workspace `platform-org` from here on, as choosing them in the Demo panel does (the browser’s storage: `goals-app-viewer:platform-org` is `tariq`).
- Go to `/check-in/ns-ai` in the demo.
- **Step.** Type {a number 105% of the way from the goal’s start to its plan for week 45} into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Check:** “Check-in saved” is shown (else: the check-in did not post).
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `label === 'Post check-in' && after - before === 1`, where `const before = (await h.snapshot()).checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ns-ai' && c.week === NOW).length`; `const label = await p.locator('form.focus-body button[type=submit]').innerText()`; `const after = (await h.snapshot()).checkIns.filter((c) => c.goalId === 'ns-ai' && c.week === NOW).length`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: three quick presses on “{label}” posted {after - before} check-ins.
- **Check:** (`finish`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
